evidence.excerpt: To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.
